title: Interpretable LLM Guardrails via Sparse Representation Steering
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured stereotype bias in language models, with religion being one of the categories for which model preferences were evaluated using the StereoSet dataset.
findings: The proposed SRS method significantly improved fairness scores on the StereoSet benchmark, which includes religious stereotypes as one of its evaluation criteria. The paper reports that SRS outperformed prior baselines in reducing stereotype bias but does not provide specific findings for the religion category alone.
